page.layout: Three columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, no full-width text. Left column: entries from "attertere" to "continendo". Middle column: entries from "præparavit" to "præparavimus". Narrow right column: Hebrew forms with abbreviations, beside the middle column. Running head at top left and right. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: הַבְּאוֹת attertere, Infin. Hiph. Rad. בָּאָה
הַכְּבֵד graves, vel gravari, Imper. vel Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּבַד
הַכְּבֵּס ablui, Lev. 13. 56. Infin. comp. ex Hoph. & Hithp. Rad. כָּבַס
הַכָּה percussit, הִכּוּ percusserunt, הַכֵּה percute, הַכּוּ percutite, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. & Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָכָּה
הֻכָּה percussus est, הֻכּוּ percussi sunt, præt. Hoph. 3. f. & pl. Rad. נֻכָּה
הַכּוּם percutite eum, הַכּוּם percutite ipsos, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. aff. Rad. נְכָּה
הָכּוֹן paratus esto, Imper. Niph. f. m. R. כּוֹן
הַכּוֹתֵנִי percutere, הַכּוֹתִי me, ו ipsum, ם eos, &c. Infin. Hiph. Rad. נָכָּה
הָכִיל continendo, Infin. Hiph. R. כּוּל
הֵכִין præparavit, præparaverunt, Hiph. 3. f. & pl. Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. כּוּן
הַכִּינוֹת præparasti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. כּוּן
הַכִּינִי, pro הַכִּינִי percute me, Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. Rad. נָכָּה
הַכִּירוּ agnovit, agnoverunt, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. Rad. נָכַר
הַכִּיתָ percussisti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. נָכָּה
הַכִּיתִי percussus sum, præt. Hoph. 1. f. R. נָכָּה
הַכְּלִם ignominiâ affici, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּלַם
הַכְּלִמְנוּ pudore affecti eos, 1 Sam. 25. præt. Hiph. aff. Rad. כָּלַם
הַכִּין firmeris, Imper. Niph. f. m. sed הַכִּין præparatus per. Hiph. Rad. כּוּן

page.notes: The scan is faint and ghosted with show-through from the other side, so many Hebrew vowel points and abbreviations in the middle and narrow right columns are doubtful. Entries such as "Niph. Rad. בָּבָה", the Hebrew roots in the right column, and the reference "Lev. 13. 56." are uncertain and should be checked against the original. Hebrew points were not reliably readable; the consonants are given as best as possible. The narrow right column may need a separate pass.
